title: Talking is not fighting: a question to the goblin must not start combat

Goblin.personality_traits: Cowardly but vicious in a pack; greedy
Goblin.combat_style: Hits and runs; flees when outnumbered

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: Keeping my hand near my sword, I ask the goblin what it wants.

actions.text: Wants? Wants you GONE. This goblin turf! But... shiny things change minds, maybe.
It holds its ground, blade low, eyes flicking between your sword hand and your coin purse.
